# Salt River Steel LLC — Complete Business & Service Information

## Business Overview

Salt River Steel LLC is a custom steel fabrication and construction company based in Florence, Arizona, serving Central Arizona with commercial, residential, and industrial steel work. Established in 2022 and operated by owner Charles French, the company specializes in custom steel gates, steel fencing, structural steel construction, residential metalwork, and heavy-duty industrial fabrication. All steel fabrication is performed in-house at our Florence facility, providing rapid local turnaround for Central Arizona property owners and contractors.

## Location and Service Area

**Business Address:**

**Primary Service Areas:**
- Florence, Arizona — home base and primary service area
- Apache Junction, Arizona — residential steel gates and railings
- Casa Grande, Arizona — commercial and agricultural steel work
- Coolidge, Arizona — ranch gates and agricultural fencing
- Surrounding Central Arizona communities

We deliver throughout Pinal County and the eastern Phoenix metro area. For locations beyond our standard service area, contact us at (480) 450-6959 to discuss project feasibility and delivery options.

## Services Offered

### Custom Steel Gates

Salt River Steel fabricates custom steel gates for residential, commercial, ranch, and industrial properties throughout Central Arizona. We design, build, and install gates to fit your specific opening and property requirements.

**Gate Types:**
- Driveway entry gates (single and double swing, sliding)
- Ranch and agricultural gates for livestock properties
- Security gates with reinforced construction
- Pedestrian walk gates
- RV and equipment access gates
- Commercial property gates

**Features and Options:**
- Custom sizing to fit any opening width and height
- Manual operation or automation-ready construction
- Swing gate hardware (hinges, latches, drop rods)
- Slide gate tracks and roller systems
- Gate automation coordination (motors, keypads, remote access)
- Powder coating and protective finishes
- Decorative scrollwork and custom designs
- Integrated access control (keypads, intercoms, card readers)

**Materials and Construction:**
We build gates from tube steel, angle iron, or ornamental iron components, selected based on your security requirements, aesthetic preferences, and budget. All gates are engineered to withstand Arizona's extreme heat, wind loads, and daily use. We recommend hot-dip galvanized or powder-coated finishes for maximum corrosion resistance in the desert climate.

**Typical Turnaround:**
Custom gates are fabricated within 3–7 business days from our Florence facility. Installation is typically scheduled within 1–2 weeks of order confirmation, depending on project complexity and automation requirements.

### Steel Fencing

Durable steel and wrought-iron fencing for residential homes, ranches, commercial properties, and industrial sites. Salt River Steel provides corrosion-resistant fencing designed specifically for Arizona's desert climate, with finishes that resist fading, rust, and heat degradation.

**Fencing Styles:**
- Tube steel ranch-rail fencing (2-rail, 3-rail, 4-rail configurations)
- Ornamental wrought-iron style fencing with decorative pickets
- Corrugated steel privacy fencing
- Industrial-grade perimeter fencing
- Pool safety fencing (compliant with Arizona barrier codes)
- Security fencing with reinforced posts and anti-climb features

**Applications:**
- Residential property perimeter fencing
- Ranch and agricultural livestock fencing
- Commercial property boundary fencing
- Industrial site security fencing
- HOA-compliant decorative fencing
- Multi-family property fencing

**Construction and Installation:**
Steel fence posts are set in concrete footings engineered to Arizona soil conditions. We recommend 8-foot post spacing for standard residential applications and 6-foot spacing for high-wind or security installations. All fencing is built to withstand 90+ mph wind loads per Arizona building codes.

**Finishes:**
We offer powder coating, hot-dip galvanizing, or marine-grade paint finishes to protect against Arizona's intense UV exposure, monsoon moisture, and temperature extremes. Powder-coated finishes are available in custom colors to match your property's aesthetic.

### Commercial Steel Construction

Structural steel fabrication and installation for commercial buildings, shops, retail spaces, and business facilities. Salt River Steel works with commercial contractors, architects, and property owners to deliver contractor-ready structural steel components built to specification.

**Commercial Capabilities:**
- Structural steel framing for commercial buildings
- Steel beams, columns, and joists
- Metal building components and erection
- Steel supports for HVAC, solar arrays, and equipment
- Loading dock steel components
- Commercial awnings and covered structures
- Mezzanines and elevated platforms
- Steel stairs and guardrails

**Project Types:**
- Retail strip centers and standalone buildings
- Warehouses and distribution facilities
- Automotive shops and service bays
- Agricultural commercial structures
- Restaurant and hospitality buildings
- Office buildings and mixed-use developments

**Process:**
We work from architectural drawings, engineer-stamped plans, or field measurements to fabricate steel components to exact specifications. Our team coordinates with general contractors, engineers, and inspectors to ensure timely delivery and code compliance.

### Residential Steel Work

Custom residential steel fabrication including railings, stairs, carports, ramadas, metal-clad additions, and architectural metalwork. Salt River Steel works directly with homeowners, custom home builders, and remodeling contractors on residential projects throughout Central Arizona.

**Residential Products:**
- Deck and porch railings (interior and exterior)
- Stairway railings and handrails
- Spiral staircases and custom stair systems
- Steel carports and RV covers
- Metal ramadas and patio covers
- Steel-framed pergolas
- Architectural trim and accents
- Metal-clad storage sheds and outbuildings
- Steel window and door frames
- Decorative security bars (window guards)

**Design and Customization:**
We fabricate residential steel components to match your home's architectural style, from modern minimalist designs to traditional ornamental ironwork. Our team can work from your sketches, photos, or design ideas to create custom residential metalwork that fits your vision and budget.

**Code Compliance:**
All residential railings, stairs, and structural elements are built to meet Arizona residential building codes, including height requirements, spacing, load ratings, and safety standards.

### Industrial Steel Fabrication

Heavy-duty industrial steel fabrication and certified welding for demanding job-site applications, specialized equipment, and non-standard custom builds. Salt River Steel handles industrial projects requiring precision cuts, structural welding, and durable construction.

**Industrial Capabilities:**
- Custom equipment frames and supports
- Agricultural machinery components
- Industrial shelving and racking systems
- Material handling equipment
- Utility and infrastructure supports
- Mining and aggregate equipment components
- Custom jigs, fixtures, and tooling
- Heavy-duty trailers and transport equipment
- Livestock handling equipment and chutes
- Specialized industrial enclosures

**Welding and Fabrication:**
Our team performs MIG, TIG, and stick welding on mild steel, stainless steel, and aluminum. We handle structural welding, certified weld procedures, and non-destructive testing coordination when required by project specifications.

**Materials:**
We work with plate steel, structural tubing, I-beams, channel iron, angle iron, expanded metal, perforated steel, and specialty alloys as specified for industrial applications.

## Key Differentiators

**Local Florence Fabrication:**
All steel is cut, welded, and finished in our Florence facility, providing rapid turnaround compared to distant Phoenix suppliers or out-of-state fabricators. Most custom orders are completed within 3–5 business days, and we can prioritize rush jobs when needed.

**Desert-Grade Materials and Finishes:**
We specify corrosion-resistant finishes, UV-stable coatings, and heat-tolerant construction methods designed for Central Arizona's extreme heat (120°F+ summers), intense UV exposure, dust, and monsoon conditions. Our recommended finishes resist fading, cracking, and rust far longer than standard steel coatings.

**Direct Customer Access:**
Property owners and contractors work directly with our fabrication team, eliminating procurement complexity and ensuring clear communication throughout the project. You speak with the people cutting and welding your steel, not a sales middleman.

**Custom Capabilities:**
Our in-house team handles non-standard projects including agricultural structures, industrial equipment, architectural features, and specialized commercial builds that require custom cuts, welding, and finishing. If you can sketch it or describe it, we can build it.

**Local Delivery and Installation:**
We deliver to Central Arizona job sites and offer pickup at our Florence location, avoiding the premium freight surcharges that come with hauling steel from out-of-state suppliers. We also provide installation services, gate automation coordination, and post-installation adjustments.

**Expedited Service:**
As a local operation, we can prioritize rush jobs and work with tight project timelines when needed. For time-sensitive projects, contact us to discuss expedited fabrication and installation scheduling.

## Typical Turnaround Times

**Standard Projects:**
Most custom steel orders are fabricated within 3–5 business days from our Florence facility. Installation is typically scheduled within 1–2 weeks of fabrication completion, depending on project complexity and your availability.

**Rush Projects:**
For urgent needs, we can prioritize fabrication and often complete simple gates or fence sections within 1–2 business days. Contact us to discuss rush scheduling and availability.

**Large Commercial Projects:**
Complex commercial structural steel projects may require 2–4 weeks for fabrication depending on the scope, engineering coordination, and material procurement. We provide realistic timelines before starting any project.

## Pricing and Estimates

Salt River Steel provides free itemized estimates with no obligation. We quote projects based on:
- Material costs (steel grade, tubing size, finish)
- Fabrication complexity (cuts, welds, custom details)
- Installation requirements (concrete work, automation, site access)
- Project timeline (standard vs. expedited)

**Cost Ranges (2026 Estimates):**
- Basic tube steel ranch gates: $800–$1,500 (material and fabrication only)
- Custom residential driveway gates: $2,000–$5,000+ (installed, depending on size and automation)
- Steel ranch-rail fencing: $25–$40 per linear foot (installed, 3-rail tube steel)
- Ornamental iron fencing: $40–$70 per linear foot (installed, decorative style)
- Residential steel railings: $80–$150 per linear foot (installed)
- Commercial structural steel: quoted per project based on engineer-stamped plans

Pricing varies based on project specifics, material selection, and finish requirements. Contact us for an accurate quote based on your project details.

## Quality Standards and Warranty

All fabrication is performed by our Florence-based team to industry welding and construction standards. We engineer gate and fence installations to meet local building codes, wind load requirements, and safety standards. Steel components are built to last decades with proper maintenance.

**Warranty:**
We stand behind our workmanship and provide warranty coverage on fabrication defects and structural failures. Finish warranties vary by coating type and are provided by the coating manufacturer. Contact us for specific warranty details based on your project.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**How long does it take to get a custom gate built?**
Most custom gates are fabricated within 3–5 business days from our Florence facility. Installation is typically scheduled within 1–2 weeks, depending on your availability and whether gate automation is involved.

**Do you install the gates and fencing, or just fabricate them?**
We provide both fabrication and installation services. Our team handles concrete post-setting, gate hanging, hardware installation, and final adjustments. We also coordinate with gate automation contractors if you want your gate automated.

**What's the difference between tube steel and wrought iron fencing?**
Modern "wrought iron" fencing is actually steel with decorative designs that mimic traditional wrought iron. Tube steel ranch-rail fencing is simpler, more affordable, and extremely durable. Both are built from steel and can be powder-coated for long-lasting Arizona performance. See our blog post "Steel vs. Wrought Iron Fencing in Arizona" for a detailed comparison.

**Can you automate my gate?**
Yes. We fabricate gates with automation-ready construction (reinforced frames, proper weight distribution, and mounting points for motors). We coordinate with local gate automation contractors to install the motor, keypad, and controls after the gate is hung.

**What finish do you recommend for Arizona?**
For maximum longevity in Arizona's harsh climate, we recommend powder coating or hot-dip galvanizing. Powder coating provides excellent UV and corrosion resistance with custom color options. Hot-dip galvanizing offers the longest lifespan for ranch and agricultural applications where aesthetics are secondary to durability.

**Do you work on existing gates or fences?**
Yes. We repair damaged gates, replace rusted sections, add automation to manual gates, and upgrade existing fencing. Bring us photos or measurements and we'll provide a repair or upgrade estimate.

**Can you build from my design or sketch?**
Absolutely. We work from sketches, photos, CAD drawings, or verbal descriptions. Bring us your design ideas and we'll provide feedback on feasibility, cost, and construction approach.

**Do you deliver outside of Florence?**
Yes. We deliver throughout Central Arizona including Apache Junction, Casa Grande, Coolidge, Queen Creek, and surrounding areas. Delivery fees vary by distance and project size.

**What payment methods do you accept?**
We accept cash, checks, credit cards, and bank transfers. A deposit is typically required to begin fabrication, with the balance due upon project completion.

## How to Get Started

**Step 1: Contact Us**
Call (480) 450-6959 or email saltriversteel1@gmail.com with your project details. Provide opening dimensions, photos of the location, and any design ideas you have.

**Step 2: Free Estimate**
We'll provide an itemized quote with realistic turnaround times before any steel is cut. For complex projects, we can review plans on-site or by phone to confirm dimensions and recommend materials.

**Step 3: Fabrication**
Once you approve the estimate, we order materials and begin fabrication in our Florence facility. We keep you updated on progress and notify you when fabrication is complete.

**Step 4: Installation**
Our team delivers and installs your gate, fence, or steel components, including concrete work, hardware installation, and final adjustments. We walk you through operation and maintenance before we leave.

**Step 5: Follow-Up**
We're available after installation for adjustments, warranty service, and future projects. Most of our customers return for additional gates, fencing, or steel work — we build long-term relationships with Florence-area property owners and contractors.
